Process LiDAR data to standardized format using the NWFVA naming convention

Source: R/process_nwfva.R
process_nwfva.Rd

Convenience wrapper around raw_to_processed() that always uses standard = "nwfva" with the ALS-pointcloud defaults (platform = "als", product = "punktwolke"), so callers processing NWFVA data don't need to know about raw_to_processed()'s more general standard/platform/product parameters. See raw_to_processed() for the full processing pipeline and check_names() for the exact NWFVA filename schema.

Usage

process_nwfva(
  path,
  campaign,
  out_dir = tempdir(),
  log_dir = tempdir(),
  region = NULL,
  from_csv = NULL,
  epsg = 25832L,
  workers = NULL,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

path

Character. Path to LAS/LAZ/COPC file(s), directory, or VPC.

campaign

Character. A single surveyarea_contractor label (e.g. "solling_sgb4"); cannot be derived from the data.

out_dir

Character. Output root directory; outputs are nested under {out_dir}/{region}/als/{year}/{campaign}/punktwolke/....

log_dir

Character. Output directory where logfiles and data summaries will be saved.

region

Character. Two-letter region code (federal states of Germany) for filename generation (e.g., "ni"). If NULL (default), region is automatically inferred from file bounding boxes.

from_csv

Character. Path to CSV file containing acquisition dates used for year correction in filenames where data does not contain valid GPS time.

epsg

Integer. EPSG code for the coordinate reference system. Default is 25832 (ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N).

workers

Integer or NULL. Number of parallel workers. See raw_to_processed().

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default is TRUE.

Value

Invisibly returns a list of output file paths (NULL for failed files).

Examples

# \donttest{
folder <- system.file("extdata", package = "managelidar")
out_dir <- tempfile("processed_nwfva_")
process_nwfva(path = folder, campaign = "solling_sgb4", out_dir = out_dir, region = "ni")
